correctness.rationale: Uniform roots and independent nonroot assignments give an exact hypergeometric-occupancy transition. Strict monotonicity of injective-on-s-point probabilities gives a simple dominant eigenvalue. Its explicit eigenprojector yields the positive sharp amplitude. Direct independent exhaustive composition checks for n=3..5 and r=2..n-1 agree with every transition, every product-rank law through k=3, every constant fiber and the two-point collision formula. Finite checks corroborate a general proof and do not replace it.

value.rationale: Uniform-rank retractions form a natural constrained generator distribution on the full transformation monoid. The all-length rank-chain and prescribed constant-output fiber counts are complete natural multiplication statistics for every 2<=r<n; the sharp positive spectral coefficient describes exact asymptotic synchronization. Unlike a routine finite table or normalization check, this solves an unbounded family of convolution/absorption questions and isolates fixed-point correlations characteristic of idempotent maps.
